---
title: "High School 5K Times: Freshman vs. Senior Year"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the matched 5K dataset and convert seconds to minutes
xc_long <- read_csv("hs_5k_freshman_senior.csv") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(freshman_seconds, senior_seconds),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "time_seconds"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = if_else(year == "freshman_seconds", "Freshman", "Senior"),
    time_minutes = time_seconds / 60
  )
```

## Average 5K Times (Freshman vs. Senior)

```{r}
# Calculate average 5K times in minutes and format as MM:SS
xc_long |>
  summarize(
    avg_seconds = mean(time_seconds),
    .by = c(gender, year)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Convert total seconds into M:SS string alongside decimal minutes
    avg_time = sprintf(
      "%d:%02d (%.2f min)",
      floor(avg_seconds / 60),
      round(avg_seconds %% 60),
      avg_seconds / 60
    )
  ) |>
  select(Gender = gender, year, avg_time) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = avg_time) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Women's 5K Times (Freshman vs. Senior)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
# Filter for women and stack all 1,000 dots (500 blue + 500 red) with no overlap
xc_long |>
  filter(gender == "Women") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_minutes, fill = year, color = year)) +
  geom_dotplot(
    binwidth = 0.2,
    stackgroups = TRUE,
    binpositions = "all",
    dotsize = 0.55,
    stackratio = 1.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Freshman" = "blue", "Senior" = "red")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Freshman" = "blue", "Senior" = "red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Women's High School 5K Times: Freshman vs. Senior Year",
    subtitle = "1,000 dots total: each of the 500 runners has 1 blue dot (Freshman) and 1 red dot (Senior)",
    x = "5K Time (Minutes)",
    fill = "Grade",
    color = "Grade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
